name: Ceramics Café, Hersham
summary: Paint your own pottery at a table on Hersham Green. Choose a plain bisque shape from the studio's range, paint it with underglaze colours, and leave it to be glazed and fired in the studio kiln, returning to collect the finished piece. A dry, sit-down activity that works as well for adults as for children.
reasonToVisit: Paint-your-own pottery studio on Hersham Green, indoors and year-round
planningDetail: Book a table by phone or online; pieces are fired and collected on a later visit
bookingNote: Call the studio to book a table, or use the online booking form at ceramicscafe.com
address: On The Green, 1 Berry Lane, Hersham, Surrey, KT12 4HN
